tasks.short: Supervise employees and subcontractors for safety.

steps.what: Supervise employees on the quality of work.
Supervise subcontractors for adherence to safety.
Check adherence to safety regulations and policies.

tasks.design: The manager supervises employees and subcontractors on site and checks adherence to safety regulations and policies. No score of a worker is produced, and nothing is filed from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quality of work and safety adherence are seen on the turbine and the roadway, not in a form.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new takes supervision off the manager.
tasks.still_hard: A missed unsafe act is a harm to a person, and it is seen only by being there.
tasks.human_edge: The manager is the person on site who can stop the work.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. Supervision of employees and subcontractors, and the safety check, stay with the manager.

reach.task: Work under supervision on the site
reach.learn: The manager was present for the safety check

evidence.claim: Watching the quality of work and adherence to safety rules is the manager's presence on site. A stored score would be an employment decision and is not made.

Setting a budget, choosing an order quantity, judging warranty coverage, approving a contract, and selecting a person are decisions the wind operations manager makes. A tool does not make them. EU data-protection rules cover employees, contractors, and residents. Scoring a worker or a candidate is an employment decision a tool must not make. National rules decide who may bind the company to a contract. The file stores only what the manager recorded. Customer calls and hiring calls are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the crew is on site and ends when the manager has checked adherence to safety policies. No record is written.
No fields are stored. The manager produces the check by being there.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. Incremental hours are zero because no new record and no new tool are added.
unknowns: Which safety regulations apply on this site.
Whether a customer already requires a separate paper safety round.
research_questions: Which safety regulations apply on this site?
Does a customer already require a separate paper safety round?

already_counted.description: The whole of supervising employees, supervising subcontractors, and checking safety policies stays with the manager

incremental.description: No added upkeep while supervision stays entirely with the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The whole task stays. If the crew is small, supervision is still the manager's time on site, and nothing is saved. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train employees on operations, safety, and environmental issues.

steps.what: Train employees on operations and safety.
Review attendance after the safety training.
File the training record the manager accepted.

tasks.design: The manager trains employees on operations and safety and coordinates training on environmental issues. Attendance is filed only after they review the list from the session they ran. The file is that list, not a score of a worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training is a session with people. The attendance list is often typed again after the session.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file can store an attendance list the manager has already reviewed, so it is not typed twice.
tasks.still_hard: Whether someone understood the safety point is still judged in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager runs the training and accepts the attendance list. The file stores that list.
tasks.altitude: Training stays with the manager. The only shorter step is filing an attendance list they have already accepted.

reach.task: Deliver a session the manager has coordinated
reach.learn: The manager still owns who must attend

evidence.claim: An attendance list the manager has already reviewed can be stored as a training record. Storing it does not score the employee.

EU data-protection rules cover employees, contractors, and residents. Scoring a worker or a candidate is an employment decision a tool must not make. National rules decide who may bind the company to a contract. The file stores only what the manager recorded. Customer calls and hiring calls are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a training session is held and ends when the accepted attendance list is on the file. The session itself stays outside the file step.
The fields are session date, topic, employee name, and attended yes or no. The manager produces the list in the session. If a name is missing, they type it. Nothing infers who attended.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the training. They disagree only about a second typing of a list the manager has already reviewed.
Upkeep is keeping the attendance field names aligned with the training record.
unknowns: Whether attendance is already written on paper at the session.
Which environmental topics a customer requires by name.
research_questions: Is attendance already written on paper at the session?
Which environmental topics does a customer require by name?

already_counted.description: Training employees on operations and safety stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the attendance field names aligned with the training record

approvals.approved_version: training attendance the manager reviewed after the safety session

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the attendance list is already written at the session, the low end is the training itself, which stays, and only a clean copy is shorter. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track site performance, downtime, parts, and substation events.

steps.what: Show the site performance for operations.
Check parts usage against the work.
Accept the record of substation events.

tasks.design: The operations system already shows site performance. The manager reviews downtime events, checks parts usage, and accepts the substation record. Only that accepted record is stored. The existing performance total is not treated as time the manager saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Downtime, parts, and substation events are often retyped into a second record after the system has already shown the performance total.
tasks.enabler_now: A record the manager has accepted can be stored once, from fields they have already checked.
tasks.still_hard: A downtime cause can be wrong even when the hours match, and the manager still has to say which event it was.
tasks.human_edge: The manager checks parts usage and accepts the record. The system keeps showing the performance total it already produces.
tasks.altitude: The manager still reviews downtime and checks parts usage. The file holds the record only after they accept it. The performance total was already on the operations system.

reach.task: Read the operations record the manager accepted
reach.learn: Parts usage was checked by the manager

evidence.claim: An operations system can keep showing a site performance total it already produces, and it can store a downtime and substation record the manager has accepted. The total is existing system time.

assumptions: The workflow starts when downtime, parts usage, or a substation event is known and ends when the accepted record is stored. The performance total the operations system already produces stays outside human time.

Upkeep is keeping the event field names aligned with the operations record.
unknowns: Whether the downtime list is already complete in the operations system.
Which substation events the manager must still write in their own words.
research_questions: Is the downtime list already complete in the operations system?
Which substation events must the manager still write in their own words?

already_counted.description: Checking parts usage stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the event field names aligned with the operations record

approvals.approved_version: operations record the manager accepted after the parts check and the downtime review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the downtime list is already complete, the low end is the parts check and the acceptance, which stay. tasks.short: Oversee maintenance of towers, transformers, and site assets.

steps.what: Oversee maintenance of towers and transformers.
Oversee roadways and other site assets.

tasks.design: The manager oversees maintenance of towers, transformers, roadways, and other site assets in person. A note is filed only after that visit, and only the note they reviewed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The oversight is the visit. The note is often typed a second time back at the office.
tasks.enabler_now: A note written after the visit can be stored once the manager has reviewed it.
tasks.still_hard: A cracked foundation or a bad roadway is seen on the visit, not in the note.
tasks.human_edge: The manager oversees the maintenance and reviews the note. The file stores that note.
tasks.altitude: Oversight of towers, transformers, and roadways stays on site with the manager. The file holds the note only after the visit and their review.

reach.task: Carry out work the manager oversaw
reach.learn: The note was reviewed after the visit

evidence.claim: A maintenance note the manager reviewed after being on site can be stored. The visit itself is not replaced by the file.

incremental.description: Keep the asset labels on the maintenance note aligned with the site list

approvals.approved_version: maintenance note the manager reviewed after overseeing towers, transformers, and roadways

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the note is already written at the tower, the low end is the oversight, which stays. Only a clean copy of a reviewed note is shorter. Provisional, not a measured result.

reach: A technician works under a safety check the manager made in person
A site lead reads an operations record the manager accepted
skills_to_grow: Keeping worker scores out of the safety check and the training record
Accepting a downtime record only after the parts check
Reviewing a maintenance note only after the site visit
